taken as written

explanation.surface: A public body changes its travel plans, and we make a complaint.
explanation.walkthrough: Rearranged trips sounds like rescheduled travel, but it signals the jumbling of all twenty-three letters.
explanation.definitionFit: The CPS is the government department that brings criminal prosecutions in England and Wales.

clue.text: Group under religious rule right to dam German river

indicators.note: a dam is built across a watercourse, so this piece is set inside the other to block it

parts.note: the Oder forms much of the German-Polish border
R is the abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: A monastic community claims the right to dam a river in Germany.
explanation.walkthrough: The German river is a crossword favourite; the dam sits in its middle.
explanation.definitionFit: A religious order, such as the Benedictines, is a community living by a shared monastic rule.

clue.text: Supply, needing to last, runs out

indicators.note: out means gone or absent, so that letter is taken away

parts.note: to endure is to last
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A stock of goods that must keep has run dry.
explanation.walkthrough: Runs out reads as a single phrase meaning 'is used up', but it splits into the abbreviation and the deletion signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To endue someone with a quality is to provide or furnish them with it.

clue.text: Friend from Bow behind elected party in Asian peninsula

indicators.note: something behind comes after, so this piece is placed last

parts.note: a candidate elected is in
a do is a party
Bow is in the East End of London, and in Cockney rhyming slang china plate means mate

explanation.surface: A friend from east London follows the winning party to Southeast Asia.
explanation.walkthrough: From Bow flags Cockney speech, where a friend is a china, short for china plate.
explanation.definitionFit: Indochina is the old name for the peninsula holding Vietnam, Laos, Cambodia, Thailand and Myanmar.

clue.text: Old king from India wheeled carriage round

indicators.note: to go round something is to surround it

parts.note: a pram is a baby carriage on wheels
India is I in the NATO alphabet

explanation.surface: An elderly monarch from India is pushed about in a wheeled carriage.
explanation.walkthrough: India is a NATO-alphabet letter, not the country, and the carriage is for babies.
explanation.definitionFit: Priam was the aged ruler of Troy in Homer's Iliad, father of Hector and Paris.

clue.text: Without the use of which one might drop dead?

definitions.text: Without the use of which one might drop dead?

parts.note: surface reading: someone collapses and dies suddenly
setter's reading: a skydiver who fails to pull the parachute release falls to their death

explanation.walkthrough: Drop dead is an idiom for sudden death, but here the drop is literal: a fall from a plane.
explanation.definitionFit: Pulling the cord on a parachute pack opens the canopy, so a jumper who never tugs it plummets.

clue.text: Day was one to have men coming into the underworld

indicators.note: coming into a place means entering it, going inside

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god of the underworld, and his realm
OR is other ranks, ordinary soldiers

explanation.surface: One day was for men descending into hell.
explanation.walkthrough: Day is not a date: it is the surname of the singer and actress Doris Day, so she was one with this first name.
explanation.definitionFit: The Hollywood star born Doris Kappelhoff was known as Doris Day, so she bore this forename.

clue.text: Villainous group in secret outrageously seizing power

indicators.note: to seize something is to grab hold of it, holding it inside
acting outrageously means behaving wildly, so the letters run riot

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A gang of villains secretly and shockingly grabs power.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the criminal organisation from the James Bond novels and films.
explanation.definitionFit: In Ian Fleming's stories the evil organisation led by Blofeld is called SPECTRE.

clue.text: House needs rice that's for cooking
